recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞為中小型、圓核、染色質均勻細緻、無明顯核仁，且只有極薄一圈淡藍色細胞質，混在正常成熟中的紅血球與顆粒球系前驅細胞之間，符合造血原細胞（hematogones）。
features: Small to intermediate lymphoid cells with very high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with homogeneous, smooth, finely dispersed chromatin
Scant rim of pale-to-moderately blue cytoplasm without granules
Admixed maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors (polymorphous background)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a polymorphous population of maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors with scattered small lymphocytes. The arrowed cells are small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round nuclei, homogeneous finely dispersed chromatin, absent nucleoli and a scant rim of blue cytoplasm. There is no monotonous sheet of blasts. Findings are consistent with hematogones (benign B-cell precursors); flow cytometry showing a normal maturation continuum (CD34/CD10/CD20/TdT) confirms this.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts form a monotonous population with aberrant immunophenotype (asynchronous CD10/CD20/CD34, over- or under-expression of CD45/CD58/CD38), whereas hematogones show a smooth normal maturational continuum on flow.
Mature lymphocytes have coarse, clumped chromatin, whereas hematogones have smooth homogeneous chromatin despite similar size.
Myeloblasts are larger with visible nucleoli, more cytoplasm and occasional granules or Auer rods and are MPO/CD13/CD33 positive.
